narrative.overview: Centered typography, near-black foundations, charcoal translucent surfaces, and precise dividers make the consulting offer readable. Soft lime marks actions and important details. The user-authorized brief replaces the earlier orange design.

rules.name: Pinned palette
rules.body: Use the five brief colors as the foundation; supporting shades serve hierarchy and translucency.

dos: Do respect reduced motion and reduced transparency.
Do keep the offer concrete and concise.
donts: Do not restore the former orange design.
Do not invent client proof or contact destinations.
Do not add large illustrations or dashboard styling.
